content: Petili kangukongana na Kolineli
Ku nnima ghwa ku Kaisalia kakibhegha mundu yumu lihina lyake Kolineli, ywene kakibha machonda nhwadali ghwa kimati kimanyikitwe handa “Kimati kya Kiitalia.”
Mwene kakibha nhyubhalila ghwa Chapanga papamu na bha kulubhagha lwake lwoha. Na kakitendagha matangalo kuatangatila makapukwa na kunnyupa Chapanga mu manjubha ghoha.
Linjubha limu pasaa tisa ya makimuhi, kakibhona mabhono gha peku peku, ndumitumi ghwa kunane ghwa Chapanga kakinhikila na kung'ombela, “ Kolineli!”

Kolineli kakinkwenjulila meho aywo ndumitumi ghwa kunane kwa lyogha, kakinng'ombela, “Kubhegha niki Bambo?” Ndumitumi ghwa kunani kwa Chapanga kakinnyanga, “Mayupo ghako na matulo ghako, ghalibhalilwa ng'obhe kwa Chapanga.
Hino, ghubhalaghile bhandu ku Yopa, bhakankeme Simoni, ywaakemitwe Petili.
Mwene kangutama ku lubhagha lwa Simoni ntendehi ghwa kutendekeha hilibhi hya mayula, na nyumba yake kibhegha ugheghela na lihibha.”
Yula ndumitumi ghwa kunani ghwa Chapanga pakabhukite, Kolineli kakiakema akandumindumi bhake abhili papamu na machonda ghwake yumu nhyubhalila ghwa Chapanga.
Kakialubhulila mihalo hyoha yiibwitukilite, mbole kakialaghila aghende ku Yopa.
Mabhono gha Petili
Kilabhu yake handa pa saa sita pamuhi, bhala bhandu andatu pabhaabheghite akali mu mwanja ugheghela na kukihikila kitami kya Yopa, Petili kakikwela kunane kukitutubhi ngati kannyupe Chapanga.
Pakabheghite mu kunnyupa Chapanga njala yikimmina, na kakipala kulyegha hilyo, peni pabhaabheghite mu kuteleka hilyo ng'ono yikintopela na kakibhona mabhono.
Kakibhona kunane kwa Chapanga kuyughuka na kilibhi handa lipinda likulu pa likihuluhwa pahi likikamulwa mu mbande hyake ncheche,
Mula mu lila lipinda kukibhegha na anyama nhanganganiko: Anyama bhaabheghite na maghulu ncheche, bhaakwabha na hiyuni hyoha hya kunhitu.
Mbole lilobhe liking'ombela, “Petili, ghuyinuke ghuhinje na ghulyeghe.”
Peni Petili kakiyanga, “Aka kaa, Bambo, kulyaghila kutandila makachu nenga ninalyegha ng'obhe kyoheli kilibhi kikanikihitwi na Chapanga na kulyeghwa.”
Lila lilobhe likilongela kangi paubhili, “Ghukotoke kuhikema hingunoghwa ng'obhe kulyeghwa hilibhi hyakatendite Chapanga kukita hingunoghwa kulyeghwa.”
Nndo aghu ghukibwituka pa ndatu, mbole lila lipinda likibhuya kunane kwa Chapanga.

Petili pakabheghite kangukangacha ghala ghakabhonihitwe na Chapanga, bhala bhandu bhaalaghilitwe na Kolineli bhakikibhona nyumba ya Simoni Ntendehi ghwa kutendekeha hilibhi hya mayula, na bhakiyima paulongolo ghwa nlyango.
Bhakikema na bhakikonya, “Bhuli, kabhegha nhenja yumu ywaakemwa Simoni ebu lihina lyake lingi Petili kangutama apa?”
Petili pakabheghite akali kanguhwacha ghala ghakabhonehitwe na Chapanga, bahala pala Nhuki ghwa Chapanga kakinng'ombela, “Simoni, bhabhegha bhandu andatu bhangukupalaha.
Ghuhuhuluke kanongola apa unani ghwa kitutubhi na ghukotoke kumaka kughenda papamu nabho, kiyaha ndo nenga nibhalaghilite.”
Hino Petili kakihuluka na kuaghombela bhala bhandu bhaalaghilitwe kuhuma kwa Kolineli, “Nenga ndo mwene yumumpalaha. Nhikila niki?”

Bhala bhandu bhakinnyanga, “Tulaghilwa na machonda kilongihi ghwa bhandu mbinda mabhoko kumi ywakakemwa Kolinelio mwene ndo mundu ywa maha muno, yunakuntundamila Chapanga na kutikilwa na Akaayahudi bhoha. Mwene kalaghilwa na nndumitumi ghwa kunani ghwa Chapanga kakulalike ghwenga ukaya kwake, ngati kayihwe malagho ghughapala kunng'ombela.”
Hinu Petili kakiakingama na kakilongohana nabho mu nyumba kati kakiapegha pa kughonja. Kilabhu yake Petili kakibhuka na kulongohana na bhala bhandu na amoo alongo kuhuma Yopa.
Pamalabho yake bhakihika ku Kaisalia, na Kolnelio kakibhegha paakialindila, kunu pakibha na ngwemuko ngulu ya alongo na aghanja bhake.
Petili pakabheghite mu kuyingila mu lubhagha, Kolinelio kakinyahuka kunkingama, kakinhokamila ngati kakantundamile.
Peni Petili kakinnyinula, paking'ombela, “Ghuyime kiyaha na nenga ndo mundu hela.”
Petili pakabheghite mu kuyobhela naywo Kolinelio, kakiyingila nkati na kakiabhona bhandu atangalo bhakwemukana.

Petili kakiaghombela, “Mwenga mungumanya yomo kukita yibha kihyengo na malaghilo ghetu Akaayahudi katame na mundu ghwa nga kubhegha Nnyahudi, kangi hata kuntyangila, peni Chapanga kang'ombela ngotoke kunhwachila mundu ywoheli kukita kangulemwa na Chapanga ebu kabha ghwa nyanyi ng'obhe.
Kwa kya agha, pamungemiteghe hika kya nga kulema. Hinu ningubhakwonya, nhalo ghani ghumunngemilite?”
Kolineli kakilongela, “Handa manjubha ncheche ghakindite, nikibhegha mukuyupa ukaya lisaa handa ali lya saa tisa makimuhi, kamu nikinmmona mundu kayima muulongo ghwangu kaghwala mapinda gha mbuletee,
na kakilongela, ‘Kolnelio, mayupo ghako ghayihwanika na matulo ghako ghakingamwa na Chapanga kwa kya bhandu kapukwa.

Ghubhalaghile bhandu bhaghende ku Yopa bhakankeme Simoni, ywaakemitweghe Petili. Mwene ndo nhenja mu nyumba ya Simoni Ntendehi ghwa kutendekeha hilibhi hya mayula, na nyumba yake kibhegha mubwegha ya lihibha.’
Kamu nikialaghila bhandu kwa ghwenga, na ghutenda maha kuhika. Hinu twabhoha tubhegha paulongolo ghwa Chapanga kughayihwa ghoha ghakakukwilikihite Bambo kutughombela.”
Petili kangualandamiha bhandu
Ndo Petili kakiyanda kulongela, “Kulyaghila hino nungumanya kya hoto kukita Chapanga kabha na ubhaghulo ng'obhe.
Mundu ghwa nnima ghwohele ywakantundamila Chapanga na kutenda ghannoghite kaayitikilwa naywo.
Munnyihwe mwenga mungumanya kukita Chapanga kakialaghila bhandu bhake kualandamiha Akaaisilaeli Nhalo ghwa Maha kukita amokole uhihimilo kwa kupitila Yesu Kilisito ywene ndo Bambo ghwa bhandu bhoha.
Mwenga Mungughamanya ghala ghabwitukilite ku nnima ghwoha ghwa Yudea kutandila ku Galilaya, Yohana pakayomolite kualandamiha bhandu nhalo ghwake ghwa Ubatiso.

Kya bhula Chapanga pakanhaghulite aywo Yesu ghwa Kunasaleti kya kunpegha Nhuki na makakala ghake, naywo kakighenda akwo na kula pakitenda gha maha na kubhalamiha bhoha bhaabheghite mukupungwa na makakala gha Nchipila, kulyaghila Chapanga kakibhegha papamu naywo.
Twenga ndo bhandu tubhonite kwa meho ghetu twabhene mihalo hyoha yiitendikitwe kwoha ku Yudea na Yelusalemu, bhakinkoma na kwa kya kummangalila mu lupingika.
Peni mu linjubha lya ndatu Chapanga kakinhyuha na kakintenda kabhonekane,
kakibhonekana kwa bhandu bhoha ng'obhe, peni kwa twenga tuuhaghulitwe na Chapanga tubheghe mayimiho tuubhonite kwa meho ghetu, na ndo tukilyegha na kunywegha naywo mbole ya kuhyuka kwake.
Kakitukwilikiha tubhalandamihe Nhalo ghwa Maha kwa handu bhoha, na kubhaghombela ywene ndo ywakahaghulitwe na Chapanga kabheghe nndumula noghwa kwa kya bhaabheghite na ukeko na bhaahweghite.
Mambuyi bhoha bha Chapanga bhakiyobhela ya kya ywombe kukita mundu ywoheli yunakunhyubhalila kaalekekehwa ulemwa ghwake ghwoha kwa mu lihina lyake.”
Bhaabheghite Akaayahudi ng'obhe bhangunkingama Nhuki ghwa Chapanga
Petili pakabheghite mukulongela malagho agho, Nhuki ghwa Chapanga kakiahulukila bhoha bhaaliyihwite lilagho lila.

Na bhala adumula unyagho bhaahyubhalilite bhakihika papamu na Petili kuhuma ku Yopa bhakikangacha kubhona Chapanga kabhapopohela lilumbo lya Nhuki ghwake kwa bhandu bhaabheghite ng'obhe Akaayahudi bhubho.
Kiyaha bhakibhayuhwa pabhayobhela mu nongelo nhanganganiko kunu pakinkweha Chapanga. Ndo apwo Petili kakilongela,
“Bhandu abha bhakingama Nhuki ghwa Chapanga handa bhula twenga patunkingamite. Bhuli, kubhegha na mundu ywoheli bha kubhakanikiha bhandu abha akotoke kubatiswa kwa machi?”
Habhu kakikwilikiha bhabatiswe kwa lihina lya Yesu Kilisito. Mbole bhakinnyupa katame nabho kwa manjubha gha mandina.
